title: Thermal Oxidizer
model_title: Recuperative Thermal Oxidizer (Burner, Combustion Chamber, Recuperator)

introduction.definition: A thermal oxidizer destroys volatile organic compounds (VOCs), odours and hazardous air pollutants by burning them. Contaminated air is preheated in a recuperator, heated by a burner and held in a refractory-lined chamber at high temperature for long enough to oxidise the pollutants to CO₂ and water.
introduction.summary: A thermal oxidizer destroys volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and odours in process exhaust by burning them at high temperature. The contaminated air is preheated in a recuperator by the hot clean gas, then passes the burner and is held in the combustion chamber long enough for complete oxidation to CO₂ and water.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Destruction efficiency rises with temperature and residence time.

temperature.title: The 3 T's: temperature, time, turbulence
temperature.description: VOCs are destroyed by holding the gas at high temperature (typically ~ 760–870 °C, higher for halogenated compounds) for enough residence time (~ 0.5–1 s) with good mixing. The recuperator recovers heat from the hot clean gas to preheat the incoming air, cutting burner fuel (typically ~ 50–70 % heat recovery for recuperative units).

video_tutorials.title: Thermal Oxidizer — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Thermal Oxidizer.
A thermal oxidizer destroys volatile organic compounds (VOCs), odours and hazardous air pollutants by burning them.
Contaminated air is preheated in a recuperator, heated by a burner and held in a refractory-lined chamber at high temperature for long enough to oxidise the pollutants to CO₂ and water.
Typical applications include paint, coating and printing exhausts; chemical and pharmaceutical vents; odour control.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Refractory-Lined Combustion Chamber (residence time), Stack (clean exhaust), Process Fan Impeller.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Thermal Oxidizer — Operation

script.narration: How the Thermal Oxidizer works.
The fan draws VOC-laden air into the system.
The recuperator preheats it with hot clean gas.
The burner raises it to oxidation temperature.
The chamber holds the gas for the required residence time.
Clean gas gives up heat and leaves the stack.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
VOCs are destroyed by holding the gas at high temperature (typically ~ 760–870 °C, higher for halogenated compounds) for enough residence time (~ 0.5–1 s) with good mixing.

video_tutorials.title: Thermal Oxidizer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Thermal Oxidizer.
Check chamber temperature, LEL and emissions.
Inspect burner and flame sensor.
Inspect recuperator for leaks and refractory.
Watch for recuperator leak: lower destruction efficiency. Common cause: thermal fatigue.
Watch for high LEL at inlet: trip. Common cause: process upset.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
